metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the count before light, the loading, and a room of three at the Feathers.

yesterday: Nine shillings are out for the journey. The rest was thirty-three pounds.
Gannet cast off on Windsor, ice, and a peace.
The paper is in the dry room. The baskets are on the ground. Augustine has the three boys.
You are in the bed with John and George. A year ago was Greenwich. The cloak is the one you have.
